from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityCDS(BaseModel):
    """Enrollment and faculty headcounts from one university's CDS report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The university name")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 'Fall 2021'")
    grand_total_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Grand Total All Students from Section B1")
    full_time_instructional_faculty: int | None = Field(description="Full-time instructional faculty count from Section I-1")
    part_time_instructional_faculty: int | None = Field(description="Part-time instructional faculty count from Section I-1")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityCDS]
